messages:
Zara (marketing): Quick sync: need a compact battlecard + routing mini-play for the 'Serving-first' webinar. Two lead angles: 'Predictable Spend' (FinOps) and 'Slay the Tail' (Platform). Keep each 2 bullets + one-line objection handler. Also want a tiny interactive idea: ROI calculator on the landing.
Kofi (growth): Agree. ROI calc needs 3 inputs max: avg tokens/session, sessions/day, caching on/off. That returns estimated $/month and delta vs unmanaged. Simple enough to A/B test on the CTA.
Lina (product): Bench numbers we can use: chat baseline uncached = $0.68/1k tokens, cached pipeline = $0.25/1k tokens (512 ctx, typical customer mix). Fallback success rate during induced congestion jumped ~2.8x. I'll attach the CSV.
bench-bot: Bench artifact uploaded: https://redwood.internal/bench/2950 (internal)
Omar (sales): Micro-rebuttals:"Why not cloud-managed endpoints?" -> "Managed endpoints are fine for dev, but production needs predictable invoices and isolation; Dedicated + Optimize delivers both." Also: "Lock-in?" -> "We support portable model manifests and can run variants across Dedicated, Hosted, or Private." Keep them one-liners.
Priya (field): Routing suggestion for leads: score rules: bench-click +20; ROI-calc used +40; webinar attended +30; asked q in Q&A +50. >60 triggers SDR+AE. Also tag accounts >$100k ARR for HighTouch. I'll map to Marketo flows.
Maya (content): I'll write 3 LinkedIn teaser lines and 4 short email subject lines (two cost-first, two ops-first). Example: 'Estimate your token bill in 30s' and 'Cut tail latency — keep your app snappy'. Need final bullets by 3pm.
Zara (marketing): Draft battlecard bullets below  please edit inline: ```
Predictable Spend (FinOps):
- $0.25 / 1k tokens with prefix caching vs $0.68 uncached (bench)
- Committed Dedicated pricing + Optimize reduces month-to-month invoice volatility
- Rebuttal: "Unexpected bills?" -> "Console + ROI calculator shows token-level and route-level cost forecasts"

Slay the Tail (Platform):
- SLA-backed Dedicated cuts 99p latency jitter ~3x during congestion (bench)
- Smart routing + model-variant fallback improves success rate ~2.8x under regional stress
- Rebuttal: "What about vendor lock-in?" -> "Portable model manifests and transparent rollouts let you move models or run variants on-prem or hosted."
```
Kofi (growth): Swap the order on Predictable Spend to lead with the $ figure in the first line (people ask price first). Also propose two CTAs: 1) "Estimate my token bill" and 2) "See our latency tail". Run AB vs. current generic CTA.
Omar (sales): Add one tiny competitive play note for SDRs: "Vs serverless: lower unit economics at sustained throughput; Vs API-only vendors: deployment flexibility and committed throughput." Keep it non-branded.
Priya (field): For HighTouch accounts add a short play: immediate AE touch if ROI-calc shows >20% savings at customer's scale. Also offer Dedicated pilot with probed SLAs.
Maya (content): I'll include one social card idea showing a tiny two-column stat: $/1k cached vs uncached + 3x improved success rate with fallback. Visual should be bold.
Zara (marketing): Action items: Lina paste CSV + confirm fallback stat (by noon); Maya deliver subjects + social card (by 3pm); Kofi spin AB test; Priya upload routing + tags to Marketo (tomorrow). I'll assemble the battlecard and drop a draft link in #docs when merged. :rocket:
Omar (sales): I'll put two 1-line outreach opens here later today (cost-first & ops-first).
Kofi (growth): I'll add tracking events: roi-calc-completed, bench-click, webinar-attend, qanda-engage, demo-request.
bench-bot: Congestion fallback test summary: successful request rate improved 2.8x with variant fallback (see bench artifact).
Zara (marketing): Great work  let's keep the battlecard short and ship it.
